mapper.select: SELECT bsn_part_id FROM mst.bsn_part WHERE use_yn='Y' AND (bsn_part_nm=#{label} OR CAST(bsn_part_id AS text)=#{label}) ORDER BY bsn_part_id
SELECT biz_plan_id,plan_ym,bsn_part_id,trgt_sls_amt,trgt_bsn_prft_amt,trgt_utlz_rt FROM fin.biz_plan WHERE plan_yr=#{year} ORDER BY plan_ym,bsn_part_id NULLS FIRST
SELECT cls_ym FROM fin.mth_cls WHERE substring(cls_ym,1,4)=#{year} AND cls_stts_cd='CLOSED' ORDER BY cls_ym
SELECT upld_stts_cd FROM sys.upld WHERE upld_id=#{id} AND form_cd='B.10'
mapper.update: LOCK TABLE fin.mth_cls IN SHARE MODE; LOCK TABLE fin.biz_plan IN SHARE ROW EXCLUSIVE MODE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sys.upld(upld_id,form_cd,scrn_id,obj_key_val,file_nm,file_path_addr, tot_row_cnt,nrml_row_cnt,err_row_cnt,wrn_row_cnt,upld_stts_cd,ovwr_yn,upld_user_id) VALUES(#{review.id},'B.10','UI-18',#{review.year},#{review.name},#{review.path}, #{result.row_count},greatest(0,#{result.row_count}-#{result.error_count}),#{result.error_count},0,#{status},'Y',#{actor}) ON CONFLICT(upld_id) DO UPDATE SET upld_stts_cd=EXCLUDED.upld_stts_cd, tot_row_cnt=EXCLUDED.tot_row_cnt,nrml_row_cnt=EXCLUDED.nrml_row_cnt,err_row_cnt=EXCLUDED.err_row_cnt
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM fin.biz_plan p WHERE p.biz_plan_id=#{id} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM fin.mth_cls c WHERE c.cls_ym=p.plan_ym AND c.cls_stts_cd='CLOSED')
